title: luma pallida
intro: Luma pallida, commonly known as Chilean myrtle, is a plant species belonging to the family Myrtaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Luma pallida include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and exhibit analgesic and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as the primary compounds contributing to its therapeutic actions.
